hdr_media.note: In-house 2 s 1920x1080 30 fps HEVC Main 10 clips of a1_bg_chart.png; the chart is encoded as BT.2020 PQ (SDR white 203 cd/m2) or HLG (BT.2408 reference white at signal 0.75) 16-bit RGB by the generator, then by FFmpeg 9.0.1 / libx265.
